title: a fixed overload is preferred over a variadic one
purpose: Fixed and variadic overloads of one name coexist; a call that fits a fixed signature never selects the variadic one.

provenance.origin: authored for typed and variadic overloads
provenance.expected_basis: spec 11.8: a fitting fixed signature is selected before any variadic one; total(1) is fixed, total() and total(1, 2) take the tail.
